calculation.expression: residual of (return_20d * sum(return_1d,10) / sum(abs(return_1d),10)) regressed cross-sectionally on return_5d
calculation.description: Compute 20-session momentum scaled by ten-session directional efficiency, then remove the contemporaneous cross-sectional linear exposure to five-session return. The residual preserves the component not explained by short-term momentum/reversal and is observable using data through the decision date.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC in all three broad regimes; small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation. Signal is materially correlated with prior efficiency momentum library artifacts and requires ensemble de-weighting.
